summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer equivalent of a US current report) on November 3, 2026, incorporating a Forty-Second Supplemental Indenture into its shelf registration. The issuer established two series of senior unsecured notes: $1,750,000,000 5.819% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Notes due 2032 and $2,500,000,000 6.262% Fixed Rate/Floating Rate Notes due 2037, with BNY Mellon London Branch as trustee and HSBC Bank USA as paying/registrar/calculation agent. Cleary Gottlieb supplied US and English law opinions. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch benchmark transition and loss-absorption redemption mechanics.
